summary: Removing a delegation now takes the access away within minutes.

fixes.title: Removals go live on the next run
fixes.text: A removed delegation is now taken away by the next run, minutes after the commit. Earlier removed rows that kept their access show as extras on Drift.

fixes.title: Permission templates moved
fixes.text: Permission templates now live under Audit & Settings > Workload templates, next to the template packs.
